name: Enterprise Fund Committee Special Meeting Agenda 6-12-2019
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  June 12, 2019 – 5:00 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall West
  Conference Room A
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California
1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Regular Meeting Minutes of April 17, 2019

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS

  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.

  A. Presentation Regarding Asset Management System for Water and Waste
  Water Staff Use – Informational Only (5 minutes)
  B. Selection of a new Chairperson and Vice Chair
  C. Discussion regarding status of Utilities Manager recruitment effort
  D. Discussion regarding extension of Agreement for Ed Diggs with Project
  Partners

7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

8.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted: June 4, 2019
